finger.en: When you feel an itch, you often scratch it with your fingers by rubbing your nails on the skin.
finger.zh: When you feel an itch, you often scratch it with your fingers by rubbing your nails on the skin.

finger.en: We're talking about itching. Now an itch is that unpleasant feeling you get on your skin that you have to scratch with your fingers.
finger.zh: We're talking about itching. Now an itch is that unpleasant feeling you get on your skin that you have to scratch with your fingers.

fight.en: And small modular reactors , which I mentioned a few minutes ago, are another way to fight the issues that have plagued the construction of these large nuclear power plants.
fight.zh: 而我几分钟前提到的小型模块化反应堆，则是解决困扰这些大型核电站建设难题的另一种途径。

fight.en: So, to wrap things up, even a couple of years ago, nuclear power was a story about a fight between the past and the future: old reactors closing in Europe while new ones opened in Asia.
fight.zh: 总而言之，就在几年前，核电还是一个关于过去与未来博弈的故事：欧洲在关闭旧反应堆，而亚洲在开启新反应堆。

financial.en: This one ran safely for decades, and only closed in 2019, for ordinary financial reasons.
financial.zh: 这一座反应堆安全运行了数十年，直到2019年才出于普通的财务原因关闭。

financial.en: Part of it might be a financial problem.
financial.zh: 部分原因可能是财务问题。

finance.en: Firstly, the financing of nuclear plants.
finance.zh: 首先是核电站的融资问题。

finance.en: If banks and investors provide you with €1 billion in financing at a 10% interest rate , let's say, that's €100 million in interest payments every year.
finance.zh: 比方说，如果银行和投资者为你提供10亿欧元的融资，利率为10%，那么每年光是利息支出就有1亿欧元。

fission.en: This is why fission plants need so many layers of safety systems, and those layers are a big part of what makes them so expensive to build.
fission.zh: 这就是为什么裂变电站需要层层安全系统，而这些安全系统正是造价如此高昂的主要原因。

fission.en: And regulators in the US have started treating fusion as a properly separate category from traditional nuclear power, with lighter rules, because a fusion reactor can't melt down the way a fission reactor can.
fission.zh: 美国的监管机构也已开始将核聚变视为与传统核电完全不同的独立类别，适用的法规更为宽松，因为聚变反应堆不会像裂变反应堆那样发生堆芯熔毁。
